It's an optical illusion: it happens when the Earth, which moves faster in its orbit, passes another planet or is passed by it. Mercurio simboliza la comunicación, el p: Mercury symbolizes communication, thinking, short trips and agreements. During its retrograde, popular tradition advises reviewing more than starting: going over contracts before signing them, confirming plans, backing up your files and picking up unfinished business.

Es la técnica astrológica que superpone: It's the astrological technique of overlaying two birth charts to study how two people's energies interact. It's used mostly for couples, but also for friendships, family or business partners.
